1339-2921-4616.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-2921-4616.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Moldervine Reclamation triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

141-1854-4247.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1854-4247.description:
Cast Makeshift Mannequin by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Makeshift Mannequin.
Holding priority, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Naru Meha, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Makeshift Mannequin
Resolve the Makeshift Mannequin copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

586-728-5626-5687.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing the Eldrazi Spawn and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

862-1003-2928-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
862-1003-2928-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

703-1430-7149.description:
Cast Mirror Image by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Mirror Image into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Mirror Image dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Astral Dragon, gaining its abilities.
When Mirror Image enters, it triggers, creating two token copies of itself, thus creating two copies of Moon with Astral Dragon's abilities, that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to its other types.
Put all but one of the Mirror Images into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Mirror Image tokens each trigger. Resolve a trigger, creating two token copies of itself, thus creating two copies of Moon with Astral Dragon's abilities, that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 5.
703-1430-7149.notes: The additional triggers can copy whatever noncreature permanent(s) you desire.

339-413-677-7297.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Blasting Station by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
When Jegantha enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

2533-3967-6909.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
2533-3967-6909.description:
Cast Carnage by paying {2}{B}{R}. 
When Carnage enters, it triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Carnage.
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning Carnage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

4681-5170-6094-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

3200-4195-4574-5741.description:
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Urza's Bauble from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Urza's Bauble from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2014-3055-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Yosei.
When Yosei dies, it and Gift of Immortality trigger.
Resolve the Yosei trigger, causing the next player in turn order to skip their next untap step.
Resolve the Gift of Immortality trigger, returning Yosei from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
At the beginning of the end step, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Yosei.
Repeat during each turn unless you are the next player in turn order.

1921-2423-4659.description:
Activate Tawnos's second ability by paying {1}{W}{U}{B}, tapping it and sacrificing two artifact tokens, exiling Bounding Krasis from your graveyard and creating a token copy of it that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
When the Bounding Krasis token enters, it triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Tawnos's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Bounding Krasis token and causing you to mill two cards.
When the Bounding Krasis token enters, it triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Bounding Krasis token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

2292-3305-4681.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing Body Launderer to connive.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Body Launderer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

3951-4772-5703-5744.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
3951-4772-5703-5744.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

1251-3259-5722.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls no creatures.
Breath of Fury attached to a creature other than Wasitora.
1251-3259-5722.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent who controls no creatures using Wasitora and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Wasitora.
Resolve the Wasitora trigger, creating a 3/3 Cat Dragon creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Cat Dragon, then causing you to untap all creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat damage.

1992-5231-5994.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with at least one +1/+1 counter.
1992-5231-5994.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a creature with at least one +1/+1 counter, adding {R}.
Basri's Lieutenant triggers, creating a 2/2 Knight creature token.
When the Knight token enters the battlefield, Securitron Squadron triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Knight.
Repeat.

725-4050-5969-5970.notablePrerequisites:
Marina does not have summoning sickness.
Spiked Corridor is locked.
725-4050-5969-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Spiked Corridor.
Spiked Corridor triggers, creating three 1/1 Devil creature tokens.
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping a Devil, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Spiked Corridor.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the tapped Devil, adding {1}.
When the Devil dies, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping a Devil, untapping Marina.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the tapped Devil, adding {1}.
When the Devil dies, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2084-5241.notablePrerequisites: Sakashima's Student is a copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm.
2084-5241.description: Activate Sakashima's Student by paying {1}{U}, shuffling Sakashima's Student into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

2267-4798-5437-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2267-4798-5437-5686.description:
Activate Prognostic Sphinx by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing another creature, creating a Blood token.
When the Blood enters the battlefield, Ovalchase Daredevil triggers, returning Ovalchase Daredevil from your graveyard to your hand.
Tormod triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.

1409-1633-3503-5184-5195.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional Spirit.
You have no cards in hand.
Spectral Arcanist is paired with Deadeye Navigator.
1409-1633-3503-5184-5195.description:
Activate Spectral Arcanist by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Spectral Arcanist enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Spectral Arcanist.
Resolve the Spectral Arcanist trigger, casting Hanabi Blast from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Storm-Kiln Aritst triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve Hanabi Blast, dealing 2 damage to any target, returning Hanabi Blast to your hand, and then causing  you to discard Hanabi Blast.
Activate both Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

967-1806-2382-2604-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding one mana of any color.
Mimic Vat triggers, exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard and returning any previously exiled creatures to their owners' graveyards.
Cast Eternal Scourge for {1}.
Prosper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Eternal Scourge, allowing it to enter the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

1628-4186-5147.notablePrerequisites:
Necrosynthesis attached to Scurry Oak.
You control another creature to sacrifice.
1628-4186-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a creature, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Necrosynthesis triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Squirrel token, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.

7-539-730-2232-3396.notablePrerequisites: At least one +1/+1 counter among creatures you control.
7-539-730-2232-3396.description:
Cast Quirion Sentinel for {G}, triggering Emeria Angel and Cloudstone Curio.
Quirion Sentinel triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve Cloudstone Curio's trigger choosing not to return another permanent.
Resolve Emeria Angel's trigger, creating a 1/1 Bird creature token with flying.
The Bird token triggers Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve Cloudstone Curio's trigger returning Quirion Sentinel to your hand.
Repeat.

1784-3492-3609.notablePrerequisites: Coretapper and Argivian Archaeologist do not have summoning sickness.
1784-3492-3609.description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, taking an extra turn after this one.
Activate Argivian Archaeologist by paying {W}{W} and tapping it, returning Coretapper from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Coretapper by paying {2}.
Repeat each turn.

2585-5149.notablePrerequisites: Power Artifact attached to Grim Monolith.
2585-5149.description:
Activate Grim Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Grim Monolith's last ability by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

224-433-907.description:
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Llanowar Scout.
Repeat.
